title: Connect an app to Vireek
intro: {{client}} wants to connect to your Vireek account through the Agent Network (MCP).
redirectTo: After you decide, you will be sent back to
scopesHelp: Untick anything you do not want to allow. You can revoke this connection at any time in Agent Network.
scopesDefaulted: The app did not ask for specific permissions, so only read access is pre-selected.
guard: Calls are limited to the permissions you choose, rate-limited and logged. Make sure you trust this app: it will act on your account's data.
noScope: Choose at least one permission, or deny.

error.title: This request cannot be completed
error.missing_params: The request is missing required information.
error.unsupported_response_type: Only the authorization code flow is supported.
error.state_too_long: The request state is too long.
error.invalid_scope: None of the requested permissions are recognised.
error.invalid_redirect_uri: The return address does not match the app's registration.
error.invalid_request: This app did not use PKCE (S256), which is required.
error.invalid_target: This app asked to connect to a different service.
error.forbidden: Only account owners, admins and security managers can connect apps.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Close this tab and try again from the app.
error.access_denied: Too many connected apps or pending requests. Revoke one in Agent Network first.
